question_or_symptom: The locked rocm-systems .gitmodules declares more submodules than the commit tree actually contains.
observation: At 92115a2941982a384de161be3f78cf9bff547027 the root metadata declares 36 paths but the tree contains 34 mode-160000 gitlinks. The stale declarations are projects/rccl/ext-src/mscclpp and projects/rccl/ext-src/json; neither path exists in the locked tree, and projects/rccl/.gitmodules is the empty blob e69de29bb2d1d6434b8b29ae775ad8c2e48c5391.
conclusion: A .gitmodules stanza is configuration metadata, not proof that a submodule exists at a particular commit.
decision: Freeze declared paths and actual gitlink paths separately, record stale and undeclared differences, and initialize only locked mode-160000 entries selected by the build dependency audit.
invalidated_assumptions: Every path declared by an upstream .gitmodules file exists as a gitlink in the same commit.
The selected RCCL source at this baseline directly requires the two stale root-level ext-src declarations.
